scope: Named resort/destination areas with an Austrian association, not regional ticket alliances. Areas may contain multiple mountains and cross-border pistes; this is not a lift-connectedness classification.

decisions.name: Ski Arlberg
decisions.label: Ski Arlberg
decisions.reason: Retain the broader resort-area polygon record; do not also rank Lech/Zürs or the duplicate point record.

decisions.name: Skicircus Saalbach-Hinterglemm Leogang Fieberbrunn
decisions.label: Saalbach–Hinterglemm–Leogang–Fieberbrunn
decisions.reason: Retain the named Skicircus resort-area record.

decisions.name: SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser - Brixental
decisions.label: SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser–Brixental
decisions.reason: Retain the named SkiWelt resort-area record, including its point geometry; polygon availability is not an eligibility requirement.

decisions.name: KitzSki
decisions.label: KitzSki
decisions.reason: Retain the resort-area record rather than separately ranking its mountain components.

decisions.name: Silvretta Arena Ischgl/Samnaun
decisions.label: Ischgl–Samnaun
decisions.reason: Retain the full named cross-border resort area; lengths are not clipped to Austrian territory.

decisions.name: Zillertal Arena
decisions.label: Zillertal Arena
decisions.reason: Retain this resort-area record, not an invented total for the entire Zillertal valley annotation.

decisions.name: Mayrhofen Hippach
decisions.label: Mayrhofen–Hippach
decisions.reason: Retain the named destination/resort-area record, including its different mountains; no claim of complete lift-connectedness.

decisions.name: Sölden
decisions.label: Sölden
decisions.reason: A point-only ski-area record still has downhill statistics; no polygon inference is needed for the ranking.

decisions.name: Ski amadé
decisions.reason: Multi-destination ticket alliance, not a single resort area; it includes regions and resorts ranked or reviewed separately.

decisions.name: Schladming Dachstein
decisions.reason: Tourism-region aggregate containing the four-mountain ski area and several additional ski areas; not the individual four-mountain resort.

decisions.name: Lech/Zürs
decisions.reason: Component of the retained Ski Arlberg record; both source records reference Skimap.org area 627.

decisions.name: Kleinwalsertal-Oberstdorf
decisions.reason: Broader multi-destination regional grouping of several mountain ski areas rather than one destination/resort record.

decisions.name: Drei Zinnen - Tre Cime, Drei Zinnen, Tre Cime
decisions.reason: Austrian association is not independently established for this predominantly Italian source footprint; excluded rather than treating the source AT tag as proof of eligibility.

decisions.name: Skigebiet Damüls-Mellau-Faschina
decisions.reason: Combined regional record including the separately described Faschina ski resort; the narrower Damüls–Mellau record is below this chart's cutoff.
